name: Camporosso (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of red and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Camporosso (a cross and stars, counterchanged) within branches, with the inscription CITTÀ DI CAMPOROSSO in yellow arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Camporosso, a comune in Liguria; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 11 May 1963.

features.role: Camporosso arms — cross and stars counterchanged, crowned, within branches
inscription CITTÀ DI CAMPOROSSO arched above the arms
